pickAColumnForThe: Pick a column for the kanban’s columns and another for the card titles
copiedAsATableIt: Copied as a table. It won’t follow later changes to the cards.
noOptionsYetAddThem: No options yet: add them from the column menu
addASelectColumnTo: Add a select column to group the rows by.
hiddenRowsHiddenByThe: {hidden, plural, one {1 row hidden by the filter} other {{hidden} rows hidden by the filter}}
editTheFirstCellOf: Edit the first cell of a table
inATableCellNext: In a table cell: next / previous cell
inATableCellAt: In a table cell, at the edge of its text: the next cell that way
aTableNeedsAtLeast: A table needs at least one row
aTableNeedsAtLeast2: A table needs at least one column
boardRowsAsCardsBy: Board: rows as cards by a select column
aTableNeedsAtLeast3: A table needs at least two columns to become a kanban: one for the columns, one for the card titles.
convertedToAKanbanWith: Converted to a kanban with {value} cards. Undo brings the table back.
tableColumnTheKanbanS: Table column the kanban’s columns come from
tableColumnTheCardTitles: Table column the card titles come from
nCardsInNColumns: {length, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} in {length2, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}:  {join}
nameofHasLengthDifferentValues: “{nameOf}” has {length} different values; a kanban has at most {max_kanban_columns} columns. Pick another column.
eachRowBecomesACard: Each row becomes a card. The kanban takes the table’s place; undo brings the table back.
